title: Postcomposition by the restricted evaluation mate is bijective
statement: For the restriction functor R and derived internal Hom H in the statement of lem-sc-derived-restriction-evaluation-mate-is-iso, every natural tensor comparison t satisfying its naturality equation induces a bijection on Hom sets by postcomposition with the explicitly displayed evaluation mate, for every L, E and every test object A on U.

proof.text: Choose a tensor-stable test object B with A≅R(B). Restriction gives bijections on Hom(B,H(L,E)) and Hom(B tensor L,E). Compose the latter with the canonical tensor-Hom equivalence on X, the supplied tensor comparison t(B,L), the test-object isomorphism tensored with identity, and the inverse canonical tensor-Hom equivalence on U. Naturality of the canonical equivalences expresses uncurrying as tensor with identity followed by evaluation. Naturality of t, cancelled by its inverse, identifies this composite bijection with postcomposition by the displayed mate after the first restriction bijection. Bijectivity cancels the first bijection. All tensor comparisons are the supplied t; no coherence or normalization hypothesis is added.
